name: VolSDF
aliases: Neural Scene Representation with SDF and Volumetric Rendering
definition: A neural inverse rendering approach that decouples geometric representation and appearance by modeling scene geometry via a Signed Distance Function (SDF) and density, allowing for stable convergence and theoretical upper bounds on opacity error compared to density-based NeRF or mesh-based surface rendering.
summary: VolSDF is a neural inverse rendering method that decouples geometry and appearance by modeling scene geometry via a learnable Signed Distance Function and deriving volume density from it.
